notes: Page 85 verified. Abba Matthew strikes ground, spring gushes forth, baptizes Sarah (instantly healed of leprosy), Mermehnam and 40 servants; Holy Communion administered; Mermehnam retreats to Mount Qesar (ደብር ዘስማ ቅሳር); rejects his father’s crown and royal garments; King orders the slaughter of the 40 servants and threatening them.
